description: This file contains the implementation of AzureQueueDataManager class, which provides utility methods for managing Azure storage queues, including creating, deleting, clearing, adding messages, peeking messages, retrieving messages, deleting messages, and fetching approximate message counts. It also defines default policies for queue operation retries and timeouts.

classes.name: AzureQueueDefaultPolicies
classes.description: Contains static default policies for Azure Queue operations such as max retries, pause duration between retries, and total operation timeout.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataManager
classes.description: Provides methods for managing Azure storage queues, including initialization, message operations, and queue management functionalities.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with logger factory, queue name, and connection options.

methods.name: ConfigureOptions
methods.description: Static method to configure AzureQueueOptions based on connection string and visibility timeout.

methods.name: GetQueueClient
methods.description: Returns a QueueClient instance, cached if already initialized, otherwise asynchronously creates and caches it.

methods.name: InitQueueAsync
methods.description: Initializes the queue by creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: DeleteQueue
methods.description: Deletes the queue if it exists.

methods.name: ClearQueue
methods.description: Clears all messages from the queue.

methods.name: AddQueueMessage
methods.description: Adds a message to the queue.

methods.name: PeekQueueMessage
methods.description: Peeks at the latest message without dequeuing it.

methods.name: GetQueueMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a single message from the queue.

methods.name: GetQueueMessages
methods.description: Retrieves multiple messages from the queue.

methods.name: DeleteQueueMessage
methods.description: Deletes a specific message from the queue.

methods.name: GetAndDeleteQueueMessage
methods.description: Retrieves and deletes a message from the queue.

methods.name: GetApproximateMessageCount
methods.description: Returns an approximate number of messages in the queue.

methods.name: CheckAlertSlowAccess
methods.description: Logs a warning if a queue operation exceeds the configured timeout.

methods.name: ReportErrorAndRethrow
methods.description: Logs an error and rethrows an exception during queue operations.

methods.name: GetCloudQueueClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QueueClient instance using provided options.

methods.name: SanitizeQueueName
methods.description: Sanitizes the queue name to conform with Azure naming rules.

methods.name: ValidateQueueName
methods.description: Validates the queue name against Azure naming rules.
